subject: general
question: Gurpurab is celebrated to commemorate the birthday of Guru Nank dev ji. He was the _________ guru of Sikhs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**first**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Nanak Dev Ji** is the **first Guru** of the Sikhs.
 
• He founded Sikhism in the 15th century and his teachings form the core tenets of the Sikh faith.
 
• Gurpurab, also known as Guru Nanak Jayanti, is one of the most significant festivals for Sikhs, celebrated with great devotion and enthusiasm.
 
• The day involves prayers, hymns, and reading of the Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture of Sikhism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Guru Nanak Dev Ji was born on **15th April 1469** in a village called Talwandi, now known as Nankana Sahib, in present-day Pakistan.
 
• His teachings emphasized the importance of equality, love, and goodness, rejecting the caste system and rituals prevalent in society.
 
• Guru Nanak traveled extensively to spread his message of peace and unity.
 
• The teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji are encapsulated in the sacred hymns of the Guru Granth Sahib.
 
• Gurpurab is marked by processions, community meals (Langar), and devotional singing (Kirtan).
